title: Special Executive Programme In Strategic Audit
description: The course provides the learner with in-depth knowledge and skills in Strategic audit Processes and techniques.
longDescription: The Special Executive Program in Strategic Audit aims to provide the learner with in-depth knowledge and skills in Strategic audit Processes and techniques. The learner will be able to inculcate a strategic vision into the audit process and analyze the financial statements to appraise it for the strategic financial and budgetary goals. The learner will be able to understand the foundation of the product portfolio. The learner will be exposed to the ideas and techniques by which the learner will be able to categorize products into one or separate portfolios and thus manage them efficiently. The learner will also be able to make investment and divestment decisions to make the product portfolio more effective for organizational profitability.
courseDetails: The Special Executive Program in Strategic Audit is designed to provide learners with comprehensive knowledge and skills in the strategic audit processes and techniques essential for evaluating organizational performance. This program equips participants with the ability to integrate strategic vision into auditing, analyze financial statements, and manage product portfolios effectively to enhance organizational profitability. lessons.title: Historic and Current Audit Process and Procedure
Understanding Risks and Current Development in Auditing

outcomes: Understanding Audit Strategy and Process: Learn the concept and significance of audit strategy in the audit process. Demonstrate the steps necessary for establishing an effective audit strategy tailored to specific business scenarios. Understand the audit process, its stages, and the roles of auditors and clients. Identify required auditing documents and their importance. Evaluate the necessity of monitoring audit practices for compliance and the repercussions of non-compliance.
Learn the concept and significance of audit strategy in the audit process.

Understand the audit process, its stages, and the roles of auditors and clients.
Identify required auditing documents and their importance.
Evaluate the necessity of monitoring audit practices for compliance and the repercussions of non-compliance.

Contemporary Audit Processes and Procedures: Gain insights into strategic audits and their role in assessing organizational effectiveness. Trace the evolution of strategic audit techniques and their adaptation to dynamic business environments. Familiarize with key laws and regulations, such as the Sarbanes-Oxley Act, and their implications for auditing practices. Analyze reporting requirements for non-compliance and the auditor's role in these scenarios. Understand Generally Accepted Auditing Standards (GAAS) and their framework for audit practices. Discuss the importance of managing conflicts of interest in auditing, including legal and ethical considerations.

Risks and Current Developments in Auditing: Define audit risk and its critical role in the financial statement audit process. Identify various types of audit risk and their implications for auditors. Examine the responsibilities of auditors, including their ethical obligations to stakeholders. Explore the relationship between accounting and auditing in ensuring the accuracy and reliability of financial statements. Understand the phases of financial statement audits, including planning, testing, and reporting. Evaluate principles guiding financial statement audits and the impact of technology on audit effectiveness.
